a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival, because we'd need two storm-free rounds before anyone holds cells. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If you have a better plan, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks the agreement. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you so the reserve can refill for you.
